title: 蜡布包着的包裹  (Wrapped in Waxed Cloth)

segments.t: Cool morning air fills the courtyard as Chen leans steadily on his iron bar. Mei steps quietly out of the café kitchen carrying three steaming mugs of coffee to join Qing and Chen. Let us listen in first.
早上好，寻宝队！趁面团还没发起来，我端了热咖啡过来。
来得正好，小美——老陈正在抬第三块石板呢！
小晴，把灯笼拿低一点，我用木块把石板稳稳垫住。
哇，快看下面那个装满干净河沙的方坑！
有人在四周砌了四块红砖头，挡住冬天的雨水！
这老办法真聪明——你们看中间放着什么。
是一个系着细绳、用厚黄蜡布包着的方包裹！
老陈，我可以伸手把它拿出来吗？
拿吧，小晴，用双手——告诉我们摸起来湿不湿、重不重。
完全是干的，出奇地轻，而且里面刚有个金属东西滑了一下！
趁楼上的窗户还没打开吃早饭，快把它抱进九号房！
我把石板放回原位，省得大家被一号桌绊倒。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
早上好，寻宝队！趁面团还没发起来，我端了热咖啡过来。
'Good morning, treasure hunters! I brought hot coffee before my bread dough rises.'
来得正好，小美——老陈正在抬第三块石板呢！
'Perfect timing, Mei—Chen is lifting the third stone right now!'
小晴，把灯笼拿低一点，我用木块把石板稳稳垫住。
'Hold the lantern low, Qing, while I prop this stone safely on a wooden block.'
哇，快看下面那个装满干净河沙的方坑！
'Oh, look down inside that neat square pocket of clean dry river sand!'
有人在四周砌了四块红砖头，挡住冬天的雨水！
'Someone lined the sides with four red bricks to keep the winter rain out!'
这老办法真聪明——你们看中间放着什么。
'That sounds like smart old engineering—and look what is resting in the middle.'
是一个系着细绳、用厚黄蜡布包着的方包裹！
'It is a square bundle tied with twine and wrapped in thick yellow waxed cloth!'
老陈，我可以伸手把它拿出来吗？
'May I reach down and lift it out, Chen?'
拿吧，小晴，用双手——告诉我们摸起来湿不湿、重不重。
'Go ahead, Qing, both hands—tell us if it feels wet or heavy.'
完全是干的，出奇地轻，而且里面刚有个金属东西滑了一下！
'It is completely dry, surprisingly light, and something metal just slid inside!'
趁楼上的窗户还没打开吃早饭，快把它抱进九号房！
'Carry it straight into Room Nine before the upstairs windows open for breakfast!'
我把石板放回原位，省得大家被一号桌绊倒。
'I will set the flat stone back in place so nobody trips over table one.'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

Brick walls, dry sand, and thick waxed cloth kept the thirty-year-old parcel safe below the courtyard stones. See you next time.
下次见！
